reviews.text: Mad King Redemption is fun and really reminded me of that Golden Axe-style arcade era that I honestly kind of miss. I also like the roguelite idea: on PC it manages to capture that “one last coin, let me try again” feeling pretty well, and even in Early Access I think you can easily get around 10 hours out of it.

This is a really great 2.5D slash 'em up game with a lot of potential. It does play a little like Golden Axe with the addition of roguelike elements that make each run feel better than the previous. The graphic style is a real standout. The graphics and lighting are very unique and the colors pop, making the scenery look magical, almost HDR like (not sure if the game actually has HDR). The action is good, although there is room for improval. Your character's hits register in a satisfying way and the general movement feels good. If the hits were a tad more slow and deliberate, it would have been even better in my opinion amd even more reminiscent of Golden Axe. There are things that other players have touched upon that could be improved. The stamina system feels a little bit unnecessary. Some of the enemies don't telegraph their attacking frames, making you unable to counter or avoid their attacks. There is platforming that can get a bit tedious until you get the hang of it. I'm sure the passionate devs will improve this game a lot over time. They are listening to the feedback and the early access version is already much better than the first, original demo. What there is so far, is very worthy of the price tag. This is a really good game as it stands now. Four playable characters, a good amount of stages and with more to come. You can spend many hours to unlock most upgrades and beat the boss. It also runs flawlessly on the SteamDeck. Here are some tips for first time players: Don't waste your gold on consumables. Gather gold to make permanent upgrades instead. Focus on the regeneration upgrade (all stars) and the perk that lets you break defences after three hits (very useful against those annoying shield carrying skeletons). Then those that reduce the damage you get and increase your attack. When jumping, pay attention to the very small mark that appears shortly under the player. It shows you where you will land. Makes platforming more manageable with fewer deaths.

很少给 EA 游戏写长评，但这次更新必须夸一句。 很多 EA 阶段的游戏都是画饼不做事，但这个开发组是真的把玩家的吐槽听进去了 —— 社区里吵得最多的几个点，这次几乎全给优化了。 酸液机制重做绝对是最大亮点，单人检查点重生、双人队友旁复活，直接解决了之前最劝退的挫败感；触发器系统全面重制，之前卡了我好几次的交互 bug 这次全修了，全程跑下来丝滑无比；敌人的攻击冲刺终于有预判空间，前摇加长之后新手也能慢慢上手，不用纯靠背板。 合作模式的容错提升特别适合休闲玩家，不用再因为失误互相甩锅。整体能感觉到游戏在往更舒服、更亲民的方向走，底子本身就不错，现在体验又上了一个台阶，后续还有成就系统要上线，未来可期，非常值得入手。

So far pretty good. Wasn't sure what to expect, but I'm impressed by the level of polish this game is at in EA. I can tell it's supposed to be pretty grindy. There's collecting money to upgrade stats and perks in between runs, much like Vampire Survivor. The background shifting perspective is done very well. Definitely makes exploring more interesting, allowing for more secrets to be found. Visually pleasing in general. There was a few moments where it kind of blocked your character, but only when there wasn't anywhere else to go so it did signal "go back to that door to continue." The game gives you a lot of space to maneuver, and you have options to move around the level pretty fast. You can run left and right, not up and down... I feel like maybe being able to run/dash up and down would benefit some areas. There's also some decent platforming sections. Combat overall was fun. Enemies progressively became more aggressive and intelligent. The boss fight I encountered was fun and unique. I forget what it's called, but your super special move where you go DBZ Super Sayan all over enemies was interesting... when you burn through your special meter you stop and collapse. That forces you to try to time it to kill all the enemies left before it runs out, or be far enough away from enemies. Because enemies can hit you when you're collapsed. Maybe they can improve hitting enemies to have a tiny bit more weight and sound. I think it's a timing issue of when the audio plays when you attack. It's not horrible, and as I progressed I got used to it. Though I still think hitting enemies should be a little more crunchy.

Okay. I'll be blunt. This is one of the best roguelikes I've ever played and it's Golden Axe coded? ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ perfect. But a few issues that needs to be addressed. So first and for most, you guys have to fix the loading problem. I've lost a lot of progress for just trying to load an area and it stays infinite. That needs to be fix because that would kill people's enjoyment in a heart beat, I promise. So working out bugs should be top priority. The combat is fluid and buttery smooth so I have no complaints other than one implement. Grabs. Being able to grab an enemy and throw them should be a pretty basic thing and I hope something like that will happen in the future. The item variety and such is great but there's some items that mount leaning and I'll be real, there's not many mounts that appears. At least in my runs so, more variety for traits and such would be fantastic. Besides that, I high recommend grabbing this. Cause mark my words, if these developers keep at it? I can see this games immediately blowing up. For what I've played, this is beyond impressive for even just three people.
